en.title: Ordering a VeloBuild frame: confirmation, paint and the parts you will need
en.description: A practical VeloBuild ordering guide covering the website-to-confirmation process, custom paint, dispatch timing and dated owner reports.
en.intro: A VeloBuild order is not finished when the payment button turns green. The useful next step is a written configuration that agrees with the frame, cockpit and paint you actually intend to build.

sections.heading: Use the official order and confirmation route
paragraphs: VeloBuild’s [ordering instructions](https://www.velobuild.com/place-order-a0025.html) describe website ordering followed by confirmation. Use the [official contact page](https://www.velobuild.com/contact-us-a0024.html) if an option or quote needs clarification, and keep the agreement attached to the order number.

The [VB-R-268 listing](https://www.velobuild.com/products/velobuild-2024-vb-r-268-carbon-fiber-aero-road-frame-disc-integrated-cables) illustrates how many choices can sit behind one frame name: size, cockpit dimensions and finish all matter. The photograph here identifies that model; it does not establish which options are included in your selected package.

Before production, ask the seller to restate the complete specification. If the checkout and confirmation disagree, resolve the difference then. A mismatch is cheaper to fix while it is still a line of text.

sections.heading: Paint time and courier time are different clocks
paragraphs: In a [February 2025 shipping discussion](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,5750.0.html), one buyer was waiting for dispatch while other owners described different experiences with painted frames and other destinations. A fast shipment elsewhere does not tell you when your finish will be ready.

Ask for the estimated production or paint completion date, followed by the transit estimate for your destination. If you approve custom artwork, save the design and confirm when changes become unavailable.

The [tracking page](https://www.velobuild.com/order-tracking-a0003.html) explains where shipment information appears. Read the carrier’s actual scans: a created label, accepted parcel and delivered box are different milestones.

sections.heading: Audit the small parts before the box leaves
paragraphs: Have the seller list the supplied headset parts, axles, hanger, seatpost hardware and cockpit pieces. Send that list to your assembler along with the current manual. Identify any parts that must be sourced separately before ordering the rest of the build.

For an integrated front end, settle bar width and stem length from a fit plan, then confirm the approved adjustment range. Do not assume that a standard-looking spacer or bearing cover from another frame will work.

Ask how a spare hanger and proprietary fastener set can be ordered later. This is not an invitation to replace manufacturer-specified hardware with a near match; it is a chance to make the maintenance plan less dependent on a future email search.

sections.heading: Read the return conditions before choosing custom paint
paragraphs: Review the [maintenance and warranty page](https://www.velobuild.com/maintenancewarranty-a0026.html), then ask which terms apply to your frame and any custom finish. Warranty claims, unused returns and buyer-requested changes are different cases.

Confirm return authorization, shipping responsibility and the effect of assembly or alteration on a return. If something looks damaged or does not match the agreed order, document it and contact the seller before modifying it.

Finish with an itemized delivered total and a build budget that includes the parts and labor outside the frame package. VeloBuild can be a hands-on project; make sure that is the project you want, rather than one discovered halfway through assembly.

zh-Hans.title: VeloBuild 订购指南：订单确认、涂装与必需配件
zh-Hans.description: 实用 VeloBuild 购买指南：从网站下单到配置确认，核对定制涂装、发货时间及有日期的车主经历。
zh-Hans.intro: VeloBuild 付款成功，不代表订单细节已经完成。下一步应形成书面配置，与真正想装的车架、把组和涂装一致。

sections.heading: 使用官方下单与确认流程
paragraphs: [VeloBuild 下单说明](https://www.velobuild.com/place-order-a0025.html)描述了网站订购后确认的流程。选项或报价有疑问时，通过[官方联系页](https://www.velobuild.com/contact-us-a0024.html)沟通，并让约定对应订单号。
[VB-R-268 商品页](https://www.velobuild.com/products/velobuild-2024-vb-r-268-carbon-fiber-aero-road-frame-disc-integrated-cables)说明同一型号背后有多少选择：尺码、把组尺寸、表面效果都重要。照片用于辨认车型，不证明你选的套餐包含哪些选项。
生产前请卖家重述完整规格。若结算页与确认邮件不一致，应当此时解决。差异还只是一行文字时，修正最便宜。

sections.heading: 涂装与快递用的是两只时钟
paragraphs: 在 [2025 年 2 月运输讨论](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,5750.0.html)中，一位买家仍等发货，其他车主则描述不同涂装及目的地经历。别处的快速运输，不能说明你的涂装何时完成。
分别询问生产或喷漆预计完成日，以及发往你的目的地的在途估计。定制图案获确认后，保存设计，并问何时起不能修改。
[物流查询页](https://www.velobuild.com/order-tracking-a0003.html)说明运输信息在哪里显示。要读承运商实际扫描：生成单号、揽收包裹、完成签收是不同里程碑。

sections.heading: 纸箱出发前，核对小零件
paragraphs: 让卖家列出碗组部件、桶轴、尾钩、座管硬件及把组零件，连同当前手册交给装配者。购买其余部件前，识别必须另购的项目。
一体前端应先按合身方案确定把宽与把立长度，再确认允许调整范围。外观标准的垫圈或上盖，不代表其他车架的就能用。
问以后如何购买备用尾钩及专用紧固件。这不是鼓励使用“差不多”的替代件，而是避免维修计划依赖未来翻找邮件。

sections.heading: 选定制涂装前，先读退货条件
paragraphs: 阅读[维护与保修页](https://www.velobuild.com/maintenancewarranty-a0026.html)，再问具体车架及定制颜色适用条款。保修索赔、未使用退货和买家要求变更，是不同情况。
确认退货授权、运费责任，以及装配或改动对退货的影响。若有损坏或与约定不符，先记录并联系卖家，别先修改。
最后取得逐项到手报价，并将车架套餐之外的配件和工时加入装车预算。VeloBuild 可以是动手项目；应当在选择时就接受这一点，而不是装到一半才发现。
